Did the medieval Church oppose science?
No — it founded the universities. The conflict thesis is 19th-century ideology, not history.
What did Galileo actually get in trouble for?
Primarily for mocking Pope Urban VIII in his "Dialogue" — a political/personal conflict, not pure epistemology vs. faith.
What is NOMA?
Gould's proposal: science covers facts, religion covers values; no overlap, no conflict. Critiqued as too simple because many religious claims are factual claims.
What is Barbour's integration position?
Science and religion can be unified into a coherent worldview — e.g., process theology, theistic evolution.
Does CSR disprove religion?
CSR explains the cognitive mechanisms that produce religion; it doesn't establish whether the beliefs are true (genetic fallacy). Most CSR researchers bracket the truth question.
Does the Big Bang prove God?
No. Lemaître (who proposed it) specifically asked the Pope to stop claiming this. The Big Bang shows the universe had a beginning; what caused that beginning is a separate philosophical question.
What happened at Kitzmiller?
2005 federal case established that Intelligent Design is not science and cannot be taught in public school science classes. Behe's "irreducible complexity" was directly refuted.
